text: The purpose of this report is to seek further instruction in relation to a development application for a site that contains a heritage resource and together with other lands is the subject of amongst other matters a zoning by-law amendment application and the related ongoing appeal to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 11, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A, B, C and D to the report (July 11, 2018) from the City Solicitor and City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 11, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential as it contains advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege. The confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 11, 2018) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council and are now public, as follows: 1.
